spec.kitLine: Affects 2 allies w/ highest final ATK
spec.assertion: Exactly 2 distinct targetIdx per activation frame, and they are the top-2 by live effectiveAtk. Fails under {kind:'allies'} (4-5 targets) and under count:1; the literal word 'final' also requires byFinalAtk:true — static-ATK ranking picks a different pair once a buff reorders the team.

shield events exist with maxHpPct 13.71, durationSec 10, amount == caster.maxHp*0.1371. Fails under (a) dropping the line as 'defensive/inert' (zero events, kills every teammate 'shielded' trigger), (b) targetMaxHpPct scaling (amount tracks the recipient's pool, not Folkwang's), (c) durationShots encoding.

buffApply value 45.7 on the SAME 2-ally set as the shield (shared '■ Affects 2 allies' header). Fails under self-scoping the buff, and under omitting it. Flagged ⛑ if the engine has no incomingHealingPct StatKey — the schema shown carries no such key, so this may be a MISSING primitive rather than a FAITHFUL line (see gaps).

Trigger identity: activation count strictly exceeds Folkwang's burstCast count over 180s, proving interval/passive keying. Fails under burstCast or fullBurstEnter keying, which pin activations to the burst/FB count.
it.skip — no enemy entity (resolveTargets({kind:'enemy'}) returns []) and no aggro model, so the line has zero observable payload; belongs verbatim in unmodeled.skill2.

maxHpFlat buffApply with targetIdx === folkwangIdx only, expiresFrame - frame == 600 (10s at 60fps), no durationShots. Fails under inheriting the block's first '■ Affects the enemy…' header or scoping to allies. Plain 'Max HP ▲ x%' = targetMaxHpPct semantics; numerically indistinguishable from casterMaxHpPct on a self-grant, so the target-set assertion (not magnitude) is the discriminator.

Counterfactual strip of the Max-HP block leaves Folkwang's totalDamage byte-identical — she carries no atkOfMaxHpPct line, so the grant must not convert to damage. Fails if the HP buff is mis-encoded as an ATK-ish stat or an HP scaler leaks in. Non-vacuity: the maxHpFlat event count goes >0 → 0 across the patch.

Distinct activation frames == Folkwang's own burstCast count (not fullBurstStart count), amount == caster.maxHp*0.329, durationSec 10, exactly 2 targets. Fails under fullBurstEnter keying, which over-credits on rotations the other Burst III completes without Folkwang casting.

spec.kitLine: Recovers 65.81% of atk dmg as HP 10s
spec.assertion: Multiple 'recovery' events per burst (>5x burst count), with ≥1 pair of consecutive tick frames exactly 60 frames apart — i.e. heal ticks:10, intervalSec:1. Fails under (a) a single instant heal (ticks:1 — one event per burst, starving an on-recovery consumer of 9 refreshes), (b) dropping the line as 'no HP pool modeled'. Targets must equal the burst shield's 2-ally set.

it.skip — the heal effect models no HP quantity (v1 boss deals no damage, nobody drops below max), so the 65.81%-of-attack-damage amount has no assertable payload; only the recovery-event cadence is observable.

No buffApply from Folkwang carries any damage-relevant StatKey (atkPct/casterAtkPct/critRatePct/attackDamagePct/damageTakenPct/hitRatePct/…). Fails under inventing an offensive buff to 'make the Defender contribute' — the measured>fudge guard. Paired with a full shield/heal strip proving teammate totals are byte-identical in THIS fixture, which is exactly why the spec asserts events, not totals.

fixtures: controlComp('folkwang', true) — single deterministic fixture (no seed), reused across every assertion via one hoisted BASE run plus two counterfactual runs (3 runComp calls total, far under the ~20 limit). Folkwang is Burst II, so the control's B1 (liter) ahead of her and B3s behind her are REQUIRED for a chain to complete and for her burst block to ever fire; a lone/unchained fixture would make the burst assertions vacuously 0===0, which the fixture-sanity test guards against. The fixed B3 slot is kept ON deliberately: a SECOND Burst III unit in the comp is what makes team Full Bursts occur on rotations Folkwang may not have cast, and that divergence is the only thing separating burstCast keying from fullBurstEnter keying on the burst shield. The fixed B3's own buffs cannot confound these readings because every assertion filters events by casterIdx === folkwangIdx.
gaps: it.skip('Taunt for 5 sec') — skill2's enemy-targeted line. Missing primitive: the sim has no enemy entity and no aggro/targeting model, so a taunt has no observable consequence at scope lock. Record verbatim in unmodeled.skill2.

it.skip('65.81%-of-attack-damage HP amount') — burst heal magnitude. Unobservable payload: the `heal` effect models no HP quantity (v1 boss deals no damage; nobody is ever below max HP). Only the recovery-event cadence/target-set is assertable, and that is covered by live tests.
